sources.usage: Beijing transport objectives: door-to-door mobility, integrated rail/bus/walk/cycle, public-transport priority and smart transport; not a local baseline.
2026–2027 Haidian road-parking management service tender: order, guidance, patrol, equipment, exception handling, backend and complaint response; not a local inventory for this package.
Haidian planning material on transit hubs, ground-floor interfaces, bicycle interchange, emergency routes and traffic impact review; not a Jing-Zhang approved plan.
Haidian slow-mobility improvement project and traffic-diversion procurement context; not a measured project outcome.
City walking/cycling priority and network-continuity policy context.
Beijing walking/cycling planning and design standard; project dimensions remain for professional review.
Accessibility, connected routes, consultation, information access and repair responsibility.
Longitudinal employer travel-demand-management evidence; methods and cautions only, not local effect sizes.
Employer TDM plan guide covering transit, carpool, bicycle, variable hours, telework and monitoring.
Public/private curbspace management research; supports time windows, responsibility and conflict logging, not local counts.
Shared autonomous vehicle and transit competition research; used to bound feeder scenarios, not to forecast Haidian traffic.
Shared automated-vehicle and transit competition study; used as a caution to test mode displacement and vehicle-kilometre guardrails jointly, with no coefficients or local result imported.
Shared autonomous vehicles in microtransit research; method context only, not a deployment approval.
Shared-mobility transition policy context for inclusion and public management; no local outcome claim.
Human-centred AI, explainability, participation and accountability context.
Mobility demand/offer matrix method across modes and operators; variables only, not local measurements.
Open activity/agent-based multimodal workflow; requires comparison against observed mode share, road volume, travel time and distance, not a Haidian baseline.
Grouped job-accessibility inequality method; supports distributional checks and does not transfer São Paulo results to Haidian.
Comparative workplace charging demand/supply study; used to require joint demand and supply survey, not as Beijing baseline.
Beijing low-altitude economy action-plan context for coordinated facilities and air-ground systems; not a local permission or route.
Civil aviation unmanned-aircraft flight-management regulation; used as safety, operation, emergency and responsibility gate, not as project approval.
SUMO official documentation for multimodal permissions, pedestrians and bicycles; method base only, requiring local calibration.
Physical/virtual multimodal traffic simulation method reference; not a local performance result.
Urban air mobility and ground-mode integration method reference; not a Beijing project permit or local demand baseline.
Vertiport connection to public transit and walking/bus infrastructure method reference; not a local siting decision.
Multimodal public-transport and bicycle efficiency/equity method reference; no local outcome is imported.

Official Beijing profile reports 3.122 million Haidian permanent residents at the end of 2024; used only as a regional population-scale coverage reference, not as workforce counts, OD, mode shares or local performance.

Synthetic population, discrete choice and MATSim network assignment method reference; used to structure a population-scale replay, with no Munich coefficients, demand or performance transferred to Haidian.
Accessibility and distributional equity method reference; used for group tails and sufficiency-style hard gates, with no external population or local outcome imported.
Multimodal bike/transit equity optimization method reference; used to motivate paired supply and equity checks, not a Haidian station siting or demand result.
Utility-based route choice with fixed and flexible transit, active modes and within-day adaptation; method boundary only, with no behavioural coefficients or local choice estimate imported.
Demand-responsive feeder area and capacity trade-off method reference; used to keep feeder expansion conditional on fixed-transit integration and capacity evidence, not as an operating plan.
MATSim official framework reference for large-scale agent-based, activity-based and multimodal transport simulation; method inspiration only, not a Haidian calibration or performance result.
MATSim book reference for population-scale activity-based demand, network interaction and iterative transport simulation; no coefficients or local outputs are imported.
Activity-pattern, tour, time-of-day, destination and mode-choice model reference; supports separating activity chains from observed local demand, without transferring estimates.

Schedule-based transit assignment with explicit vehicle capacity, departure-time/stop/run choice, residual capacity and within-day queue formation; method boundary only, with no local coefficients or Haidian performance imported.
Multimodal disruption and mode-shift method reference; supports early information and bounded rerouting logic, not a Haidian incident forecast or delay result.
Robust transit path guidance under disruption and demand uncertainty; used to motivate explicit fallback and uncertainty gates, with no local demand or performance imported.
Equitable transit network design under supply uncertainty; used to keep efficiency and worst-group equity as separate screening objectives, not as a local policy result.
Beijing urban-rail disruption rescheduling method reference; supports grouped departure-time and FIFO fallback design, not a Haidian timetable or observed delay claim.
Large-scale activity and agent-based transportation-equity method reference; supports access-to-opportunity and grouped heatmap review, not Haidian calibration or a local equity result.
Shared micromobility and public-transit equity method reference; supports station-level supply and subsidy questions, not a Haidian station siting or demand estimate.
Multimodal transit and shared autonomous mobility network-design method reference; supports first/last-mile and fixed-transit protection questions, not an operating plan or local coefficient.
Rolling-horizon preference-based multimodal trip-planning method reference; supports time-window and customer-segment sensitivity, not local choice coefficients or a Haidian service forecast.
On-demand multimodal transit equity and equality method reference; supports absolute/relative accessibility and distributional review, not a Haidian equity outcome or operating recommendation.

People-and-parcels shared-mobility agent-based evaluation reference; supports keeping logistics service quality and passenger service visible together, not local delivery demand or environmental performance.

Multimodal public-transport service-quality method reference; supports separating reliability, comfort, safety, accessibility, information and customer-service dimensions, not a local satisfaction survey.

First- and last-mile accessibility study of disabled transit riders; supports treating the access and egress legs as explicit checks, not as a transit-average assumption, with no local rider or route result imported.

Multi-objective dynamic route-planning method for vulnerable road users; supports explicit preference changes for walking and cycling comfort and environment, with no Haidian weights or performance imported.
